title: Location reinsurance count field
text:
Location reinsurance count field

Touchstone
 field specifying the number of
 reinsurance treaties for a location.

Select an exposure view, a contract in the contract list, the 
Contract
 Details
 pane, and then the location.

You can view, edit, and add 
location
 reinsurance
 by selecting the 
Reinsurance
 tab at the
 bottom of the 
Locations
 tab, or by selecting the 
Location ID

 and then selecting the 
Reinsurance
 tab in the 
Location
 Details
 pane.
